item: P2-T02 — Workspace transfer must be transactional
summary: transferPageAction's two sequential writes (subtree workspaceId updateMany + root re-parent update) now run inside one array-form prisma.$transaction([...]). New ledger-based test suite proves fail-first (pre-fix the subtree update persisted when the re-parent failed) and green after.
transaction_form: array-form $transaction([...]) — chosen because the two writes have no reads/IO between them, making it the minimal correct form; no side effects (revalidate/log/webhook) were moved inside
fail_first_evidence: Temporarily reverted to the pre-fix sequential form; vitest failed with: AssertionError expected ['page.updateMany'] to deeply equal [] — then re-applied the fix and the suite passed.
